about: Anima's own market index. Add a plugin, MCP server or persona pack with a pull request. Every entry needs a public source; installs run on the owner's computer, so describe what it does honestly.

plugins.name: 一言
plugins.desc: 动画、文学、诗词里的一句话；她会在合适的时候引用，也能 /一言
plugins.author: Anima

plugins.name: 关键词回复
plugins.desc: 群规、链接、暗号这类固定回答，不经过模型、不花钱
plugins.author: Anima

plugins.name: 倒数日
plugins.desc: 记下考试、生日、旅行，她会记得还剩几天，当天提一句
plugins.author: Anima

frameworks.name: NoneBot2
frameworks.note: 在 NoneBot 项目里装插件（nb plugin install …），用 OneBot V11 正向 WebSocket 连到 Anima 的桥接端口

frameworks.name: Koishi
